visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide shot of a bustling crowd on Dihua Street in Taipei during the Lunar New Year market. People in winter jackets are queuing outside a storefront adorned with blue banners and white text. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a pink and white striped sweater, stands in front of the 'TASTE PLUS' shop, gesturing energetically with her hands while addressing a crowd. (3) The scene shifts indoors where the woman reacts with high surprise, covering her mouth with both hands in front of a blue wall featuring a geometric pattern. (4) The woman is then seen standing next to an elderly man with white hair. They are holding an iPad box together; she points at the device and smiles broadly. (5) A young man wearing glasses, a grey hoodie, and a white baseball cap appears indoors holding a postcard. (6) The video concludes with the woman laughing uncontrollably with her mouth wide open in front of the shop entrance as the guest interacts with her.
